item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-9b44a892e0ae7603","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that Egyptian authorities continued arrests of actual or perceived critics amid an ongoing crackdown on dissent; it described Alaa Abdel Fattah as sentenced after a grossly unfair trial for activism-related charges and reported continued denial of lawyer access and British consular visits. The report also stated that hundreds of politically detained people were released after the Presidential Pardons Committee was reactivated, but Abdel Fattah was excluded.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report was published in 2024 and describes detention practices and the Presidential Pardons Committee during and before 2023; it is relevant as near-period evidence but not exclusively confined to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the practices to Egyptian authorities under President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi’s administration; it does not establish that Sisi personally ordered each detention or denial.","limitations":["Amnesty is a human-rights organization and the passage presents its assessment rather than a judicial finding.","The source concerns a prominent individual and does not quantify all 2023 cases."]},{"source_id":"SRC-812d4b74ae97d0da","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In December 2017, Egypt and Russia signed an agreement to begin work on the Dabaa nuclear power plant, planned as four reactors costing up to $21 billion, with construction expected to finish in 2028–2029; Russia extended a loan to cover construction costs.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"This is a pre-2023 policy commitment with implementation extending into the 2023 period; the source does not report 2023 operational outcomes or safety performance.","ruler_attribution":"The agreement was signed by the Egyptian government during Sisi’s presidency; the source does not detail his individual decision process or safeguards.","limitations":["The report does not assess nuclear safety, inspection, financing sustainability, or implementation progress in 2023.","The project concerns civilian nuclear power, not a nuclear-weapons program."]},{"source_id":"SRC-812d4b74ae97d0da","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The source reported that Egypt and Russia were discussing military airspace and air-base access, and that Egypt and Russia both backed Libyan commander Khalifa Haftar.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.5","2B.8","2B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The reported arrangements and support date from before 2023 and provide background to Egypt’s regional security posture during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the positions to Egypt and Russia under their respective governments; it does not specify Sisi’s personal operational orders.","limitations":["The passage does not establish the scale, legality, or 2023 continuation of the arrangements.","It does not document civilian harm, arms transfers, or accountability outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-254b9f1e98e41b39","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"On 1 November 2023, Egypt accepted 81 injured and sick people from Gaza for treatment. WHO reported that Egypt and its partners established triage, stabilization, and medical evacuation arrangements, including 65 fully equipped ambulances, 13 ambulance teams with trained emergency doctors, a main referral hospital at Al-Arish, and onward referral arrangements.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.6","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated 1 November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the decision and national arrangements to Egypt and its Ministry of Health; it does not identify Sisi’s specific directive or resource authorization.","limitations":["WHO reports the system and facilities but does not provide patient outcomes or assess the full scope of Egyptian humanitarian access.","The source does not establish whether the arrangements were sustained throughout the period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e2d21a5893be11c7","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Egypt’s National Election Authority announced on 18 December 2023 that Abdel Fattah al-Sisi won a third presidential term with 39,702,451 votes, or 89.6% of valid votes. Three other candidates received 4.5%, 4.0%, and 1.9%; voting was conducted through 9,376 polling centers and 11,631 subcommittees, with about 15,000 judges supervising and 67 million eligible voters.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.8","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated December 2023 and reports the election held in December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The result and administration are attributed to the National Election Authority; the source does not independently assess Sisi’s influence over the electoral process or the competitiveness of the contest.","limitations":["The source is a state-affiliated Egyptian news outlet reporting the official result.","It provides administrative and vote totals but no independent assessment of media access, opposition conditions, ballot integrity, or coercion."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cde5a738db1a3bbe","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Egyptian rights organizations reported that at least 40 people reappeared before the State Security Prosecution between late 2022 and February 2023 after more than three years of disappearance; they alleged torture, incommunicado detention, altered disappearance dates, and reliance by prosecutors on National Security records. The organizations stated that more than 3,600 people had been forcibly disappeared from 2013 through January 2023 and that authorities had not held implicated Interior Ministry and National Security personnel accountable.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published 20 February 2023 and covers cases through January-February 2023, with some incidents originating earlier.","ruler_attribution":"The organizations attribute the conduct to state security forces, National Security personnel, and prosecutorial authorities under the Egyptian government; the source does not prove Sisi’s personal knowledge or order.","limitations":["This is an advocacy press release based on monitoring by rights organizations, not an independent judicial determination.","The aggregate figure spans 2013–January 2023 and should not be treated as a 2023-only count."]},{"source_id":"SRC-811a499cb0718bd6","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Egyptian Presidency website described the Takafol w Karama program as providing conditional cash assistance targeted at poor and needy families using social and economic indicators, and described the Decent Life initiative as aiming to improve conditions for vulnerable groups nationwide. It also reported that the surgery waiting-list initiative had performed 1,161,786 surgeries since its launch in July 2018.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The page is undated in the supplied extract and describes programs active during the Sisi presidency; the surgery figure is cumulative from 2018.","ruler_attribution":"The programs are presented as presidential initiatives associated with Sisi, but the extract does not provide a 2023 budget, implementation audit, or independent outcome evaluation.","limitations":["This is an official presidential source and presents program aims and a cumulative output claim.","It does not establish actual coverage, distributional incidence, service quality, or 2023 marginal results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-99d96e86c8b3085c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The UN Treaty status page states that the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons entered into force on 22 January 2021 and lists 95 signatories and 75 parties as of 1 August 2026; the supplied participant list does not list Egypt among the states shown as signatories or parties.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The treaty entered into force before 2023, while the supplied status date is after the target period; it provides treaty-status context rather than a 2023 act by Egypt.","ruler_attribution":"The page does not attribute a decision to Sisi or provide an Egypt-specific statement.","limitations":["Egypt’s absence from the supplied participant list is indirect evidence and does not explain its policy rationale.","The status date is 2026, not 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-886a65b4f492c5b1","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The Federation of American Scientists profile states that Egypt had not made significant efforts to develop nuclear weapons, had concentrated on conventional forces and chemical and biological capabilities, had ratified the NPT in 1981, and had cooperated with the IAEA after a 2004–2005 investigation found previously undisclosed uranium experiments to be minor; it reports no subsequent noted IAEA issues in the profile’s coverage.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.4","1B.6","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The profile was updated in 2012 and therefore supplies historical background rather than a 2023 assessment.","ruler_attribution":"The evidence concerns Egypt’s state posture across earlier governments and does not establish a Sisi-era decision or 2023 conduct.","limitations":["The page predates the target period by more than a decade.","It includes poorly attested historical claims and does not evaluate the Dabaa project’s later safeguards or implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae0247abd0924908","start_unit":17,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"A World Bank record identifies an Egyptian Cabinet and Information and Decision Support Center presentation dated 2 October 2023 titled State Ownership Policy Document. It describes the presentation as part of a World Bank/Arab Monetary Fund workshop on the MENA SOE Compact, intended to promote state-owned-enterprise reform through peer learning and international good practices.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The document date and publication date are 2 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The record attributes authorship to the Egyptian Cabinet and Information and Decision Support Center, not specifically to Sisi.","limitations":["The supplied extract contains metadata only and not the policy’s substantive rules, implementation, or outcomes.","Participation in a workshop does not establish enacted reform or compliance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fb9941c554ddfc8e","start_unit":7,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"The WHO Universal Health Coverage Partnership profile lists ongoing Egyptian health-financing activities: analysis of the political economy of health-financing reforms, an impact assessment of the Universal Health Insurance System focused on equity, service coverage, and financial protection, development of strategic purchasing and provider-payment options, and institutionalization of health-expenditure tracking and National Health Accounts.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The supplied profile is associated with the partnership’s current program and does not provide a clear 2023 date; it is relevant as evidence of ongoing reform activity but not a period-specific outcome.","ruler_attribution":"The profile describes WHO-supported work with Egypt; it does not identify Sisi’s personal role or establish that the proposed assessments and reforms were completed.","limitations":["The extract reports planned or ongoing technical activities and indicators, not completed reforms or welfare outcomes.","No 2023 spending, coverage, equity, or financial-protection results are supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4fd39b9b10d85649","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"On 24 July 2023, Sisi met the justice minister and was briefed on court digitization, artificial-intelligence use, and judicial-body connectivity. The official report stated that courts had completed 88% of about 1.5 million civil cases filed in 2020–2022, 98.4% of about 1.4 million family cases filed in 2021–2022, 95% of about 26 million misdemeanor cases filed in 2020–2022, 90% of 460,000 civil appeals, and 94% of more than 400,000 family appeals; Sisi directed continued efforts to finish cases in the year filed.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.6","6B.2","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated 24 July 2023, though most case totals cover earlier filing years.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency attributes the meeting, policy direction, and requested continuation of efforts to Sisi; the reported completion figures are presented by the Justice Ministry.","limitations":["The source is an official presidential statement and does not provide independent verification, quality measures, or information about judicial independence.","Completion rates do not establish fair-trial quality, remedy, or equal access."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus contains several undated, post-2023, or historical documents; period fit is stated per record and no scores are assigned.","Official and advocacy sources are represented with their attribution and evidentiary limitations; absence of evidence is not treated as evidence of absence."]}
